_comments: The recording ledger's columns are owned by its stored procedures (spRecordAIAgentSessionRecordingShard, spStampAIAgentSessionRecordingTerminal, spClaim/spFinishAIAgentSessionRecordingAssembly, spStampAIAgentSessionRecordingFile). A stale entity save must never write or clear them (#6010): a session copy loaded before the terminal stamp and saved as the close sent _Clear=1 for each NULL column and wiped the stamp. AllowUpdateAPI=false makes CodeGen leave them out of spUpdateAIAgentSession, so no entity class (an app's own subclass included) can write them. RecordingStartedAt is not here: it stays updatable.
